summary: Grant Parish, LA Kisatchie National Forest tower near Pollock; 1984 report says manned daily; Wikipedia says torn down, last USGS label 2012.

facts.status_note: Wikipedia says torn down; last labeled on a USGS map in 2012 and not found on aerial imagery. No source describes the site today.

events.note: Rainfall totals reported as recorded at the tower: 47.95 inches for 1956 and 54.84 inches for 1955
A 1984 Town Talk item quoted on the Central US Lookouts page says the 100-foot tower was manned every day unless it rained

notes_for_editor: Thin record. No build date or builder found. The 1984 staffing and the 1957 rain totals come from newspaper items quoted on the Central US Lookouts page, not checked against the original papers. Wikipedia gives the location as Pollock, Grant Parish, and the brief's coordinates match. Do not confuse this with the Catahoula Lookout Site (US 855, LA 2), a different Kisatchie tower in Grant Parish (us-la-catahoula). The Kisatchie National Forest site page was not read. No photo found.
